name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2025-02-04.130.2) introduced by Tasmanian Senator [Jonathon Duniam](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/jonathon_duniam) (Liberal), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That, in the opinion of the Senate, the following is a matter of urgency:* > > *The need for the Nature Positive bills to be withdrawn from the Notice Paper, and for the Prime Minister to guarantee that this legislation will never be returned to the Parliament.* The Nature Positive bills are the: * [Nature Positive (Environment Protection Australia) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7192) * [Nature Positive (Environment Information Australia) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7193) * [Nature Positive (Environment Law Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7195)
